name: CryptoZR DAO Token
description: ZRT is the governance token of ZRDAO, a decentralized autonomous organization led by crypto artist CryptoZR. Through a sixteen-year on-chain issuance of 201 periods, the treasury is continuously replenished with the artist's works, building a global art self-governance community with full functions of co-creation, collection, curation, investment, trading and incubation.
